tools.name: URL DECOMPOSER
tools.description: Break down any URL into components. Flags suspicious TLDs, IP-as-hostname, excessive subdomains, potential XSS/traversal in parameters.

tools.name: CIPHER WORKBENCH
tools.description: Caesar cipher encoder/decoder with auto-crack via frequency analysis. Slide the shift or let the analyzer find the key automatically.
tools.python: decoded = ''.join(chr((ord(c)-65+shift)%26+65) if c.isupper() else c for c in text)

tools.name: LOG SCANNER

tools.python: import re; matches = [l for l in lines if re.search(pattern, l, re.I)]
